business_problem: modernize a legacy healthcare warehouse so data from many practice-management systems could be validated, standardized, and reported faster under tight budget and staffing constraints.
solution_summary: East Health Trust PHO uses Snowflake, Medicly Eightwire data exchange, Coalesce, and Qlik Sense to modernize primary-care data management and reporting for East Auckland and Franklin. Data from multiple practice management systems used by 19 general practices flows through Medicly into Snowflake, where the organization validates, transforms, and standardizes it instead of maintaining complex on-prem processes. Coalesce automates transformation work, while Qlik Sense exposes business intelligence views for clinicians, pharmacists, finance teams, and other users. The Snowflake-based environment aligns with Health New Zealand’s National Data Platform, improves security and scalability, and creates room to add immunization, screening, census, and socio-economic datasets over time. The result is a future-proof population-health warehouse that cuts long processing jobs to about an hour and supports richer, more timely care reporting.
